component.name: DSH Office
component.summary: AI-native office suite built on DSH (local-first)

description.p: DSH Office is an AI-native office suite built on DSH. Local-first: no account, no login, install and use.
## 100% data control Your documents, databases and notes live on your device by default. No vendor lock-in.
## Truly native experience Faster, more stable, with full offline support. One codebase (Flutter + Rust) for desktop and mobile.
## Open source Driven by an open AGPL-3.0 codebase forked from the AppFlowy ecosystem; built and extended by the OpenMuseAI community.
